description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the FineractEntityAccessReadService interface, specifically the FineractEntityAccessReadServiceImpl class. It provides methods for retrieving entity access mappings, SQL queries for access control, and related data within the Fineract system, which is an open-source banking platform. The class interacts with a relational database via JdbcTemplate, manages entity relation mappings, and handles security context to tailor access based on the current user.

classes.name: FineractEntityAccessReadServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the FineractEntityAccessReadService interface, providing database access methods related to entity relationships and access control within the Fineract system.

classes.name: EntityRelationMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set rows to FineractEntityRelationData objects representing entity relation types.

classes.name: GetOneEntityMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to retrieve a single entity mapping record from the database.

classes.name: EntityToEntityMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result rows for entity-to-entity mapping details, including related entity names.

methods.name: getSQLQueryInClause_WithListOfIDsForEntityAccess
methods.description: Generates a comma-separated list of entity IDs for SQL IN clause based on entity access mapping data.

methods.name: retrieveEntityAccessFor
methods.description: Retrieves entity access mappings for a given entity type, related ID, and user context, optionally including sub-offices.

methods.name: getSQLForRetriveEntityAccessFor
methods.description: Constructs the base SQL query string for fetching entity access relationships.

methods.name: getSQLQueryInClauseIDList_ForLoanProductsForOffice
methods.description: Builds SQL IN clause string with entity IDs for loan products accessible by an office.

methods.name: getSQLQueryInClauseIDList_ForSavingsProductsForOffice
methods.description: Builds SQL IN clause string with entity IDs for savings products accessible by an office.

methods.name: getSQLQueryInClauseIDList_ForChargesForOffice
methods.description: Builds SQL IN clause string with entity IDs for charges accessible by an office.

methods.name: retrieveAllSupportedMappingTypes
methods.description: Queries the database for all supported entity relation types.

methods.name: retrieveEntityToEntityMappings
methods.description: Retrieves mappings between entities based on mapping ID, from ID, and to ID.

methods.name: retrieveOneMapping
methods.description: Retrieves a single entity-to-entity mapping by mapping ID.
